source: Averaged from the guided fight recordings of adult players (dev/moves/plans/fight.csv) by dev/animation/extract_moves.py: 2D poses of RTMPose, the torso lifted to 3D with VideoPose3D (MMPose, one frame). The lifter was trained on Human3.6M, whose license allows only academic, non-commercial research. Check this before releasing the game with this file.
format: Each frame: arms [his left, his right], each [shoulder rotation.y, rotation.x, rotation.z, elbow rotation.x]; legs [his left, his right], each [hip rotation.x, rotation.z, knee rotation.x]; torso [rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z]; head [rotation.x, rotation.y, rotation.z]; offset: the shift of the body [x, y, z] in meters. Raw rotations of the pivots of the rig (radians, Euler order YXZ), his left arm and leg at -x. 'hit' is the frame of the peak (the impact of a strike).
